claims.claim: The committed implementation changes only publication lineage validation and its scoped publication and authoring-ingress regression tests, without adding lifecycle or semantic authority.

Recursive lineage validation now accepts a historical zero-delta CODE_FIX attempt only when an exact canonical EXECUTION or COMPLETION_GATE failure proves clean, transportable, repairable, unchanged state; malformed histories remain fail-closed.
A successful CODE_FIX completion still requires HEAD advancement and a non-empty authorized committed delta.

Regression coverage models CODE_FIX authorization, truthful zero-delta pre-verification failure, CONTINUE_IMPLEMENTATION authorization, and successful RESULT traversal through publication and SUBMIT_REVIEW ingress.
